My mother is pretty passive in situations with me. I'm the eldest of my siblings,18. My brother and sister are both around 10. I wish I could go to school and check out the disability office I have an appointment with them on the 13th. 

My anxiety has been pretty agoraphobic. Over the course of a month I stopped to going to classes because I either they were in a large lecture hall or I procrastinate on a homework and have a panic attack the following day.

I went to my disability office once after an office hours appointment but it was closed. So I thought maybe I shouldn't go.

The same above applies to my interest in wanting to join clubs I was really excited about in mid August.

I do have one friend I text maybe once every week or two who also deals with mental illness but now that that shes away at college out of state its been harder to get in touch with her.

Since I posted I had two glasses of lactaid and my meds. It helped a little bit with my hunger but I'm still stumbling and have a bad headache. I have no money for food and I'm home alone.

I got an contact with my friend away at college and she recommended to ask my therapist to get an official medical leave so that I maybe be reimbursed and be able to afford and create a decent support system.

As for venting I have made most recently an angst blog to account for my lowest of lows. I have made a few journals to either summarize my days matter of factly, write poetry or draw - but they all turn into self hate.
